snapshot.name: Packrift Pack Count Unit Signal Gateway

endpoints.description: Open the Packrift Pack Count Unit Signal Gateway homepage.
endpoints.response_description: HTML overview of the compact gateway and source Pack Count and Unit Signal Atlas.

endpoints.description: Fetch aggregate Packrift pack-count and unit-signal stats.
endpoints.response_description: Public JSON stats for pack-count distributions, unit-signal bands, source atlas counts, and count-treatment boundaries.

endpoints.description: Fetch sample public Packrift unit-signal rows.
endpoints.response_description: Public-safe sample rows with SKU, product URL, family, pack count, unit-price snapshot band, unit-weight snapshot band, and source signal URL.

endpoints.description: Enumerate Pack Count Unit Signal Gateway crawlable URLs.
endpoints.response_description: XML sitemap containing gateway home, manifest, OpenAPI, data, methodology, and compact support URLs.

snapshot.agent_notes: Read-only public gateway. Authentication is not required; no account, login, private access material, or 2FA is required. Pricing for this reference corpus is free. Unit values are static public snapshot signals from the source Pack Count and Unit Signal Atlas, while Packrift.com remains the source of truth for buying, pricing, availability, shipping, and delivery. This is not a buyer-transaction, carrier-rate, supplier-economics, margin-math, private-source-path, or private-access-material source.
snapshot.description: Packrift Pack Count Unit Signal Gateway exposes a compact public API and dataset surface for static Packrift pack-count, unit-price snapshot, unit-weight snapshot, pack-class, family, and product-type signals from the already published Pack Count and Unit Signal Atlas. It is a reference surface for agents and crawlers, not a buying, fulfillment, carrier-rate, supplier-economics, margin-math, buyer-transaction, or availability source.
snapshot.x_packrift_count_boundary: Static public reference data only. Packrift.com remains source of truth for buying, current price, availability, shipping, and delivery.
